title: Chocolate Muffins with Ganache
description: Tall domes like bakery royalty, fluffy like a hymn, dipped in butter-rich ganache — decadent perfection.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and instant coffee (if using).
In another bowl, whisk together melted butter, oil, eggs, milk, cream, and vanilla until well combined.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients. Stir gently until just combined — do not overmix. A few small lumps are fine.
Fold in chocolate chips gently with a spatula.
Fill muffin cups about 3/4 full using a large spoon or ice cream scoop.
Bake at 175°C for 22-25 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out with just a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before dipping in ganache.
For the ganache: Heat cream in a small pot until steaming but not boiling.
Place chocolate chips in a heatproof bowl and pour the hot cream over them.
Let sit for 5 minutes without stirring, then stir gently from the center outward until smooth and glossy.
Add softened butter and stir until fully incorporated and silky. Add vanilla and instant coffee if using.
Let ganache rest until it reaches your desired consistency: 10-15 minutes for dipping, longer for spreading, or cool to room temperature for piping or filling.
Dip muffin domes directly into the ganache or spoon ganache over the tops.
Chill briefly in the fridge (10-15 minutes) if you want the ganache to set firmly.

notes.title: Extra Soft Texture
notes.content: Add an extra tablespoon of oil if you prefer an ultra-soft, tender crumb.

notes.title: Crumbly Texture Fix
notes.content: These muffins are intentionally soft and plush. If they feel too crumbly or fall apart when cold or reheated, try reducing the baking time by 2-3 minutes or adding an extra tablespoon of cream next time.

notes.title: Getting That Dome
notes.content: If the muffins don't dome beautifully, increase the oven temperature by 10-20°C for the first 5 minutes of baking, then reduce to 175°C for the remainder.
